home.meta_title: Pchelin Med — Natural Honey & Mead from Bulgaria
home.meta_description: Pchelin Med offers natural honey and handcrafted mead direct from the apiary. Order with cash on delivery.
home.hero_heading: From the hive to your table
home.hero_body: Hand-harvested honey and fermented mead from Rhodope beekeepers — delivered straight to your door.
home.honey_body: A variety of honeys — from delicate acacia to dark mountain. Each jar carries the taste of the season.
home.mead_body: A traditional fermented drink made from pure honey and spring water. Smooth, aromatic, and unique.
home.value_natural_body: No additives or preservatives. Just honey, bees, and flowers.
home.value_local_body: We work with small family apiaries in the Rhodopes and the Balkan mountains.
home.value_craft_body: Every batch is limited and carefully tracked from hive to jar.
home.story_body: It all started with a love of bees and the unspoiled nature of Bulgaria. Today we unite dozens of small beekeepers to bring their craft directly to your table.

about.meta_description: Learn about our story and values.
about.heading: About us
about.intro: We unite small family beekeepers from the Rhodope and Balkan mountains to bring authentic honey and mead directly to your table.
about.story_p1: It all started with one beehive and a boundless love for Bulgaria's unspoiled nature. Our founders are children of beekeepers — raised among hives, flowers, and the scent of beeswax.
about.story_p2: Over the years we realised that real honey — raw, unfiltered, with its aroma intact — is hard to find on shop shelves. So we decided to connect producers directly with people who care about quality food.
about.story_p3: Today we work with over 20 small apiaries in Bulgaria's mountain regions. Every batch is limited, traceable, and certified. Our mission is simple: honey the way it should be.
about.v1_body: No additives, no preservatives, no heat treatment. Just honey, bees, and flowers.
about.v2_body: We work exclusively with small family apiaries from the Rhodopes, the Balkan range, and Strandzha.
about.v3_body: Every batch is limited, numbered, and carefully tracked from hive to jar.

cookie_banner.heading: We use cookies
cookie_banner.body: This site uses only functional cookies: to confirm your age (required for alcoholic beverages), to remember your language preference, and to secure the admin area. We do not collect personal data and do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
